There is no software update available to RAFI displays. I have spoken with Michele about this and Product Care is already aware of this issue. They need the next information:
- Is the lag issue permanent?
- Is it disappearing after reboot?

I will move the ticket back to you but please provide me the feedback so I can forward to Product Care.
